slice.label: Slice to migrate (a module or folder), or whole

steps.title: Write the intent
steps.prompt: Write {{run.dir}}/INTENT.md: the goal ({{inputs.goal}}), the target stack ({{inputs.target_stack}}), the slice ({{inputs.slice}}), and what must not change for users. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Assess the slice
steps.prompt: Tests passed before any change: {{steps.preflight.outputs.passed}}. For the slice in {{run.dir}}/INTENT.md, write {{run.dir}}/assessment.md: file inventory, complexity, debt, security risks, and whether there is a way to capture the old code's outputs. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Map dependencies and data flow
steps.prompt: For the slice in {{run.dir}}/INTENT.md, write {{run.dir}}/map.md: entry points, dependencies in and out, and how data flows through it. Split the slice into three modules that can move one at a time and name them in order. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Extract the business rules
steps.prompt: Read the code in {{run.dir}}/map.md. Write every business rule as Given, When, Then with its file and line. Write {{run.dir}}/rules.json as a list of items with id, title (the rule), preview (file and line), reason and status pending. Set the output key items to that path. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Re-check each rule
steps.prompt: Re-check every rule in {{run.dir}}/rules.json against the code at its file and line. Add a reason to any rule that is wrong, vague or missing a case, and add rules that were missed. Write {{run.dir}}/rules-check.md. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Confirm the rules
steps.gate_summary: Approve or drop each rule in {{run.dir}}/rules.json, reading {{run.dir}}/rules-check.md. Approve to plan the migration against the approved rules.

steps.title: Write the phased plan
steps.prompt: Write {{run.dir}}/plan.md: one phase per module named in {{run.dir}}/map.md, the approved rules from {{run.dir}}/rules.json each phase must keep, and how old and new outputs will be compared. Write {{run.dir}}/module-0.md to module-2.md, one per phase. Do not edit the repository.

steps.title: Approve the plan
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/plan.md. Approve to rebuild the three modules in their own worktrees.

steps.title: Rebuild one module
steps.prompt: Rebuild the module in {{run.dir}}/module-{{index}}.md in {{inputs.target_stack}} in this worktree, keeping every approved rule in {{run.dir}}/rules.json. Commit on the current branch. Do not push.

steps.title: Prove old and new match
steps.prompt: Run the old module from {{project.path}} and the new one in this folder on the same inputs, covering each rule in {{run.dir}}/rules.json that {{run.dir}}/module-{{index}}.md names. Write {{run.dir}}/prove-{{index}}.md with each input, both outputs and match or not. Set passed to true only when every output matches.
